column1: # Translator-variant sweep — holds orchestrator + answerer fixed, varies the
# translator (keyword extraction) model. Tests the hypothesis that translator
# quality materially affects recall quality and therefore answer quality.
# Requires multiple translator processes on different channels. This sweep
# assumes the operator launches the desired translator externally with
# MARINA_MODEL set to the tested value; the orchestrator always points
# Format: orchestrator | benchmark | limit | seed | extra
# (operator notes record which translator was running for each group)
# --- Group 4: no translator (control — baseline recall on raw question) ---
